Chi cerchiamo Hai esperienza nel settore automotive come Brand Manager, responsabile vendite o venditore senior con coordinamento di una squadra. Hai solide capacità commerciali e di negoziazione. Decidi partendo dai numeri e usi con sicurezza CRM, reportistica ed Excel. Guidi le persone con autorevolezza ed esempio, più che con la gerarchia. Sono un plus la conoscenza della Brianza, dei processi delle Case Madri e dei prodotti finanziari e assicurativi. Cosa offriamo Un ruolo di responsabilità con visibilità diretta sui risultati e sulle scelte commerciali della sede. RAL tra 35.000 e 40.000 euro, commisurata all'esperienza, più un piano incentivante su risultati personali e di squadra. Brand storici e brand in forte crescita nella stessa sede: un contesto in cui costruire, non solo gestire. La solidità di un gruppo nazionale come Intergea e le opportunità di crescita che ne derivano. Orario di lavoro: 40 ore settimanali, dal lunedì al sabato. Sede di lavoro: Seregno (MB). Segnala offerta di lavoro Candidati ora Senior Manager Sales, Italy Olympus Italia Srl (OIT) | Funzione Tipo di impiego: Luogo Segrate Numero Del Lavoro 80014651-22102026 Contatti Hannah Nash Sito Web https://www.olympus.it With about 175 employees, Olympus Italia SrL, based in Segrate, near Milan, is responsible for the distribution on the Italian territory of Olympus products dedicated to the healthcare and research market, such as: medical systems products (rigid and flexible endoscopes, microscopy) and industrial products (endoscopy, microscopy, high speed cameras and security technology). Le tue responsabilità For more than 100 years, our mission has been to make people's lives healthier and safer. We achieve this through innovation. As pioneers in technology, we design and deliver solutions across our Medical and Scientific divisions that make a positive contribution to society. Our products are essential for advancing scientific research and helping healthcare professionals diagnose, treat and prevent diseases. In the medical field, we develop and manufacture state-of-the-art technologies for diagnosis and therapy, ranging from endoscopes to electrosurgical devices. We are looking for a Senior Sales Manager – GI-ET/RESP to join our organization in Italy, based in Milan. Reporting directly to the Cluster Business Unit Leader GI-ET/RESP, the successful candidate will be responsible for leading commercial activities across Italy, coordinating the direct team of Territory Managers and the network of sales agencies operating nationwide. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on commercial management, with overall responsibility for driving sales performance and business growth in Italy, strengthening customer relationships and ensuring the achievement of commercial objectives, in close collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Sales Strategy & Business Development: Define and implement the national sales strategy, identify business growth opportunities and translate strategic priorities into clear commercial action plans to achieve sales and business objectives. Sales Team Leadership: Lead, coordinate and develop the direct team of Territory Managers, fostering collaboration, accountability and a strong results-oriented mindset. Agency Management: Coordinate and support sales agencies operating across Italy, ensuring alignment with the company's commercial strategy and business objectives. Budget & Performance Management: Take full ownership of sales performance, budget achievement and commercial execution across ET (GI & Respiratory) in Italy, ensuring effective forecasting, KPI management and timely corrective actions. Customer Relationship Management: Develop and strengthen relationships with strategic customers and key stakeholders, including healthcare decision-makers and scientific associations. Tender & Negotiation Management: Oversee public tender processes and commercial negotiations, coordinating the Sales Force and Back Office in collaboration with the Marketing Team. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Technical Service and other internal stakeholders to translate business strategy into effective commercial initiatives, product launches and field execution, while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. Events & Scientific Engagement: Coordinate the organization and management of congresses, training courses and other events across the country. Le tue qualifiche University degree preferred, ideally in business, economics, life sciences or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Extensive experience in sales and sales management roles within the medical device or MedTech industry. In-depth knowledge of the Italian healthcare market and public administration. Proven experience in public tender management and commercial negotiations. Proficiency in written and spoken English. Willingness to travel nationwide according to business needs. Le tue competenze Strong leadership and people management skills, with experience coordinating sales teams and indirect sales networks. Strong business acumen and results orientation, with the ability to translate strategy into actionable plans. Excellent negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical skills and experience managing budgets, KPIs and commercial performance. Excellent organizational skills, flexibility and the ability to manage complex situations and work under pressure. I tuoi vantaggi Joining Olympus means contributing to a mission that puts people's health at the center, while working in an international, innovative and collaborative environment. We are committed to supporting our employees' professional development, wellbeing and work-life balance. Compensation Package: Employment under the Italian Commerce Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL Commercio), with an annual gross salary .paid over 14 months instalments, comprising a fixed component and a variable component. The final compensation package will be determined based on the candidate's professional experience, skills and level of autonomy, ensuring alignment with the role and internal pay equity. Company Car: A company car for both business and private use, provided as part of the benefits package for employees in business and field-based roles. Social Benefits: Access to company initiatives and benefits designed to support employee wellbeing and contribute to a positive working environment. Career Growth & Development: Opportunities for professional growth within the company, supported by mentoring programmes, personalized career development plans and regular performance reviews. Birthday Leave: One additional paid day off on your birthday, giving you the opportunity to celebrate your special day with your loved ones. Learning & Development: Access to training courses, workshops, e-learning platforms and opportunities to attend industry conferences and events, supporting continuous professional and personal development. Corporate Volunteering: Opportunities to participate in corporate volunteering initiatives and contribute to social and environmental responsibility projects, making a positive impact on the community. Psychological Support: Access to a professional and confidential psychological support service, offering guidance and assistance during challenging personal or professional situations and promoting emotional wellbeing and work-life balance. At Olympus, we believe in the value of people, collaboration and innovation to improve patients' lives. If you are ready to leverage your commercial expertise and leadership skills in a meaningful, high-impact industry, we look forward to hearing from you! Full-Cycle Talent Partner | APAC EU | Talent Strategy & Advisory | Scaling Teams Across Multiple Markets Kō wai mātou? Who are we? Zespri is more than simply the world's single-largest marketer of kiwifruit. We like to think of ourselves as fruit on a mission and as rebels with a cause: to help people, communities and the environment around the world thrive through the goodness of kiwifruit. We are proudly the world's largest marketer of kiwifruit, selling kiwifruit in more than 50 countries. We work with around 2,800 New Zealand and 1,500 international growers and post-harvest companies to source the best-quality Zespri Kiwifruit which we supply through our distribution partners to wholesale and retail customers. We are one of New Zealand's best-known international brands, dedicated to creating sustainable long-term value for growers. He aha te mahi? What's the role? Based in Milan, the Key Account Manager is a part of the IT Med team, who will drive Zespri’s sales and brand development across the region, with a primary focus on Italy. You’ll build strong relationships with key retail accounts and execute retail strategies that grow the kiwifruit category and strengthen Zespri’s in-store presence. Please take note that this is a 12 months fixed term opportunity. Accountabilities Drive sustainable business growth Support Zespri’s growth strategy and drive its execution across IT Med. Build long-term, mutually beneficial relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Grow B2B customers through Joint Business Planning (JBP). Grow volume, value and brand visibility Develop and execute POS, trade marketing and shopper activation plans across channels. Partner with retailers to deliver effective sales promotions and omnichannel shopper activations. Create targeted trade and sales materials. Lead category management, including range and merchandising recommendations that meet shopper needs and grow the kiwifruit category. Work with the local KAM team to manage Customer Funds, measure ROI and optimise channel and shopper investments. Partner with the Market Manager IT Med to respond to changing customer, competitor, shopper and supply conditions. Support forecasting, stock control and day-to-day sales operations. Analyse performance and identify opportunities to close gaps and accelerate growth. Apply best practices from within Zespri and other industries to strengthen channel development. Be Zespri’s eyes and ears in the market Monitor local market developments and recommend proactive and reactive actions. Ensure retailer and distributor agreements are followed through. Track kiwifruit and wider fruit-market pricing and key category measures. Gather insights to support effective category management. Contribute to the wider team Collaborate proactively across European and global teams, contributing insights that help shape Zespri’s future strategic direction. Ko wai koe? Who are you? You’ll bring 3–5+ years of sales and trade marketing experience, ideally from fresh produce or FMCG, together with a strong understanding of the Italian retail market. You’ll also have: A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics or a related discipline. Strong analytical skills and confidence turning data and insights into commercial decisions. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills. Native-level Italian and fluency in English. A proactive, agile and results-driven approach. Strong problem-solving, communication and relationship-building skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams. Resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced environment. Flexibility to travel throughout the IT Med region. He aha e tika ai a Zespri? Why Zespri? Our people are what makes our culture so irresistible and uniquely Zespri. We are a passionate and mighty team of 850+ employees in 23 different locations globally. Working at Zespri is an opportunity to join a fast-paced, culture-driven environment unlike any other. We want people who share our values of making it happen, creating real connections, and leaving a legacy. Join us in shaping our future and be part of a truly unique organisation. Competitive base salary of between EUR54,000 and EUR59,700. Please note that individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, performance and work location. FlexWELL flexible work ethos; WFH & the office. Additional paid annual leave day per year (Zespri Day). Global Life and Permanent Disability Insurance. Group Medical Insurance benefits Tono mai inaianei! Apply Now! Applications close 2 December 2026 At Zespri, we understand the importance of diverse perspectives and experiences, and a fair hiring process is the first step to getting there. We want to attract a diverse range of people and encourage everyone from all backgrounds and walks of life to apply. Please let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments to take part in the recruitment and selection process by reaching out to our Talent Acquisition team via email at careers@zespri.com. Agency Zespri will not accept applications or contact from any temporary staffing agency, placement service or professional recruiter for this vacancy (“Agency”). Where Zespri requires the support of an agency to fulfil a vacancy, we will proactively seek this support from our network of Agencies. We respectfully ask that you do not contact Zespri or any of its affiliates/employees regarding vacancies, and reserve the right not to reply. Zespri will not be responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions or other payments related to such unsolicited resumes. Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da DuPont Sara García Kinane Sara García Kinane At DuPont, our purpose is to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. We work on things that matter. Whether it’s providing clean water to more than a billion people on the planet, producing materials that are essential in everyday technology devices from smartphones to electric vehicles, or protecting workers around the world. Discover the many reasons the world’s most talented people are choosing to work at DuPont. Why Join Us | DuPont Careers You are a team player, who has an agile mindset and thinks outside the box? This opportunity is perfect for you! - join the new DuPont Water “Projects” team now. DuPont Water Solutions (DWS) is a $1.4 Bn water technology leader, focused on solving global challenges in water purification, conservation and reuse. DWS serves its thousands of customers in diverse markets using multiple technologies from its portfolio across major geographies of the world. We offer excellent development opportunities, advanced training possibilities, attractive compensation & benefits and flexible working conditions. Together, we’re turning possibilities into real world answers that help humanity prosper! Come realize how you can make an impact, act like an owner and partner with customers in our journey. Water Solutions is seeking a Sales- and Project Manager - Internal Sales, for the DuPont Water business in EMEA to grow the business within the region. The position is part of the “projects” group in the commercial organization of DuPont Water Solutions. This committed role will provide a challenging mixture of commercial and technical activities to accelerate project growth with all integrated product lines. The individual responsible for this role will reside in Milano (Italy), Greifenberg (Germany), Dubai (UAE) or Tarragona (Spain). The purpose and scope of the job or role: why it exists Provide commercial and basic technical support for project opportunities from qualification to execution through whole project lifecycle. Lead the project execution of large projects including coordination with internal functions and customers. Support large and complex projects with document control, contract management and structured project execution. Prepare integrated UF, MBR and RO proposals, quotations and supporting documentation. Act as the interface between customers, commercial teams, and internal functions. Contribute to customer satisfaction, profitable growth and delivery of agreed project commitments. What You'll Do Support contract review and negotiation, including scope, milestones, payment terms, guarantees, warranties, liabilities and change management. Coordinate document control, submittals, quality documentation and customer approval processes for large and complex projects. Prepare proposals, tender documents and technical and commercial clarifications. Translate contractual obligations into clear actions, deliverables, responsibilities and project plans. Lead project kick-off and execution, coordinating Customer Service, Engineering, Technical, Quality, Manufacturing, Logistics, Finance, Legal and field-service resources. Track scope, schedule, risks, changes, invoicing, payments and customer commitments through project close-out. Support sales teams with opportunity development, customer requirements, forecasts and reporting. Provide product guidance and coordinate inputs from Technical Specialists and other internal functions. Manage direct quotations for customers, spare parts and pilot plants in alignment with the responsible sales teams. Support order clarification, after-sales activities and customer communication throughout the project lifecycle. Critical Success Factors Strong customer and sales-support orientation with solid commercial and technical understanding. Experience preparing proposals, quotations and tender documentation for water-treatment projects. Ability to manage multiple opportunities while providing structured support to large projects. Knowledge of complex contracts, including review, negotiation, risk assessment and execution. Document-control, coordination and project-management capabilities. Ability to work across functions and regions and communicate clearly with customers and internal stakeholders. Structured working style, sound judgment, proactive problem solving and ability to perform under pressure. What You Need To Succeed Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management or an equivalent qualification. Relevant experience in Sales, Technical Sales, Technical Service, Contract Management or Project Management in water treatment or a comparable project business. Commercial and basic technical knowledge of UF, MBR and RO technologies. Experience with large international projects, project documentation and complex contracts is beneficial. Understanding of project economics, contracting, payment terms, guarantees, logistics and international trade. Proficiency in Microsoft Office; Salesforce, CPQ, SAP and project-planning tools are beneficial. Fluent English; additional languages are beneficial. At DuPont, we have an unbridled commitment to deliver essential innovations that enrich people’s lives, enable sustainable development, and foster human potential for generations to come. Innovations developed from highly engineered products and naturally sourced ingredients to shape industries and everyday life. From smarter homes to more efficient cars, from beer ways of digitally connecting to new tools that enable active and healthy lifestyles…in all these areas and many more, we’re working with customers to transform their ideas into real world answers that help humanity thrive. Diesen Job melden VF Corporation is looking for an exceptional Regional Process Owner Manager to join our team based in Stabio, Switzerland, on a permanent basis. Let’s talk about the role! The Regional Process Owner (RPO) is accountable for the design, governance and continuous improvement of the Engage-to-Cash (E2C) process across EMEA, from customer engagement and order capture through fulfilment and cash collection. The RPO ensures the process is executed consistently against agreed standards, while evolving it to meet changing customer expectations, market dynamics and fashion industry requirements. The role drives process harmonization, operational excellence and digital enablement , acting as a trusted partner to cross-functional teams and senior leadership. The RPO is a key influencer in shaping how the business delivers customer value efficiently, compliantly and at scale. Acting as the voice of the customer within E2C, the RPO reviews existing processes against customer feedback and business needs, balancing customer expectations with internal capabilities to deliver a seamless and responsive experience. Primary Accountabilities: PROCESS DESIGN AND STANDARDIZATION Drive the consistent implementation of E2C processes and services across EMEA brands, markets, channels and functions, in line with the agreed North Star process design. Maintain process integrity, promote leading practices and identify opportunities to simplify and harmonize ways of working. Document regional processes, controls, standards and procedures to support consistency, auditability and adoption. GOVERNANCE AND ISSUE RESOLUTION Lead regional E2C governance forums and act as the primary point of contact for systemic process issues. Lead root cause analysis for recurring problems and coordinate sustainable corrective actions through established governance forums. Monitor process risks, dependencies and decisions, escalating material issues to the appropriate process and functional leaders. CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT AND PERFORMANCE Identify and prioritize improvement opportunities using process data, customer and business feedback, risk, cost and benefit analysis. Lead quick wins and improvement initiatives from definition through implementation, tracking adoption and benefits realization. Define and monitor key E2C performance indicators (e.g. order accuracy, on-time-in-full, first-time-right, cycle time) and use the insights to improve process quality, service and efficiency. TECHNOLOGY AND INNOVATION Partner with Digital Technology and Business Intelligence to evolve the systems, tools and reporting that support E2C, including SAP, B2B platforms, Mobimedia, PKMS and dashboards. Translate process needs into clear business requirements and contribute to the regional E2C technology roadmap. Promote appropriate use of automation, analytics and AI-enabled capabilities to improve accuracy, throughput and customer experience. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION AND CHANGE Partner with Sales, Customer Operations, Distribution and Logistics, Finance, Planning, Digital Technology and EMEA brand teams to ensure end-to-end alignment. Influence stakeholders across functions and countries, constructively challenging legacy practices where they limit E2C outcomes. Act as an E2C subject matter expert and change agent, supporting communications, training and adoption of new processes and tools. COMPLIANCE AND RISK MANAGEMENT Ensure regional E2C processes reflect applicable internal policies, controls and relevant local or regional requirements. Coordinate required local process accommodations without compromising overall process integrity and standardization. Proactively address control gaps, compliance risks and audit findings in partnership with the relevant functions. Skills for Success and Key Competencies: University degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering or a related field. 3+ years of experience in Order-to-Cash / Engage-to-Cash, customer operations, commercial services or process excellence, ideally in a multinational, multi-brand environment (fashion, apparel, footwear or consumer goods preferred). La missione Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in contesti tecnici , preferibilmente nella meccanica, micromeccanica o meccanica di precisione, capace di coniugare competenza tecnica, visione commerciale e attenzione alla qualità del servizio. La risorsa selezionata garantirà una gestione efficace e puntuale del processo commerciale, dalla richiesta iniziale del cliente fino all’evasione dell’ordine, assicurando precisione operativa, affidabilità e qualità nella relazione con interlocutori internazionali. Le responsabilità Gestire le anagrafiche clienti e l’intero ciclo dell’ordine, dall’inserimento al monitoraggio fino alla consegna. Analizzare le richieste dei clienti e interpretare il disegno tecnico, verificando la coerenza delle specifiche. Predisporre offerte commerciali, valutando con attenzione le caratteristiche tecniche dei prodotti e le esigenze del cliente. Verificare la disponibilità dei prodotti, monitorare l’avanzamento degli ordini e coordinare le informazioni relative alle consegne. Gestire la corrispondenza commerciale e mantenere aggiornati i clienti sullo stato delle forniture. Verificare e predisporre, ove necessario, la documentazione di trasporto, origine della merce e import-export. Gestire reclami, resi e note di credito, contribuendo alla risoluzione tempestiva delle problematiche. Collaborare con le diverse funzioni aziendali per ottimizzare i processi e migliorare continuamente il livello di servizio. Coordinare le attività di un piccolo team, favorendo collaborazione, organizzazione ed efficacia operativa. Monitorare la qualità del servizio e individuare opportunità di miglioramento. Il profilo ideale Formazione superiore in ambito tecnico, economico, commerciale o linguistico . Potete lavorare da casa, ufficio o direttamente dai clienti in Svizzera, Italia o in qualsiasi altro Paese che parli una delle sei lingue disponibili. Chi cerchiamo Stiamo cercando rappresentanti indipendenti, agenti plurimandatari oppure venditori con ditte individuali che abbiano voglia di aggiungere al proprio portafoglio di prodotti e servizi, una tecnologia molto valida in ambito IA applicata alla gestione automatica delle telefonate in entrata. Non parliamo di contact center cosiddetto "outbound" ovvero "chiamate in uscita", bensì un sistema per aiutare gli imprenditori, soprattutto piccoli, a gestire le chiamate in entrata. Studi medici, dentisti, specialisti sanitari Singoli professionisti in ambito salute, massaggiatori, terapisti, fisioterapisti, naturopati Garage, riparatori, carrozzieri Alberghi, BnB, affittacamere Ristoranti, pizzerie anche d'asporto Parrucchieri e centri estetici Avvocati e commercialisti / fiduciari Centri sportivi, campi da gioco, palestre Veterinari Agenti immobiliari Consulenti assicurativi e finanziari Questo è solo un esempio delle possibili verticalizzazioni, ma in realtà il servizio può essere utilizzato da chiunque. Qual è il servizio Il servizio di cui parliamo è YUNES AI, è il marchio di un'azienda svizzera Swissvoip SA che opera in qualsiasi mercato in 6 lingue: italiano, inglese, francese, tedesco, spagnolo e russo. Volete approfondire? Qui il link di riferimento. https://ai.yunes.ch/brochure.html?ref=B69YUG&lang=it Potete anche registrarvi gratuitamente e provare il servizio. In pratica Yunes AI risponde alle telefonate dei tuoi clienti 24 ore su 24, con una voce naturale e nella loro lingua, e fissa gli appuntamenti direttamente nella tua agenda — o, se sei un ristoratore, gestisce tavoli, coperti e ordini da asporto in modo automatico. Risponde anche ai messaggi del tuo WhatsApp Business. La retribuzione L'agente riceve, su base mensile, il 75% del fatturato generato dal cliente per il primo anno. Negli anni successivi riceve il 10% del fatturato. Salvo diversi accordi da valutare caso per caso. Quindi un abbonamento enterprise su base mensile di 299,99 CHF dà diritto all'agente a 56,25 CHF mensili per i primi 12 mesi e 22.50 CHF dal 13* mese in poi finché il cliente è attivo. Se il cliente cambia pacchetto, le provvigioni vengono adeguate a partire dal mese della variazione. Il pagamento Le provvigioni maturate sono visibili sul portale di back office e vengono liquidate mensilmente o trimestralmente a scelta dell'agente dietro presentazione di idonea fattura. Contratto Il contratto è quello di agente o procacciatore d'affari indipendente. È escluso il rapporto dipendente, a meno che non si raggiunga uno storico consolidato per almeno 12 mesi di lavoro. In tal caso è possibile discutere un'assunzione a condizioni da determinarsi. Come candidarsi? Du verbindest technisches Verständnis mit einem Gespür für geschäftliche Anforderungen und bringst Business, Finance und IT zusammen. Mit dir verbinden wir Preislogiken, Vertragskonditionen, Nutzungs- und Ereignisdaten sowie Rating, Charging und Fakturierung zu einer skalierbaren End-to-End-Lösung. Das kannst du bewirken. Du entwickelst die technische Produktvision, die Roadmap und das Backlog für Pricing und Billing gemeinsam mit Business Ownern, Business Engineering, Finance, Architektur und Umsetzungsteams. Dabei führst du die technische Umsetzung von Standard- und Vertragspreisen, Preisregeln, Rabatten, Zuschlägen, Staffeln und kundenspezifischen Konditionen bis zur abrechenbaren Position und Rechnung. Du stellst die eindeutige Referenz zwischen Product Offering, Vereinbarung, Preislogik, Nutzung beziehungsweise Event sowie Rating, Charging und Billing sicher. Zudem koordinierst du Integrationen zu Produkt- und Vertragsmanagement, Leistungsdaten, SAP- beziehungsweise Billing-Komponenten, Analytics, Support und Kundenkanälen. Du priorisierst Features und Enabler, steuerst Lieferteams und Anbieter und sicherst Betriebsfähigkeit, Nachvollziehbarkeit, Auditierbarkeit, Performance und Fehlerbehandlung. Darüber hinaus validierst du den End-to-End-Billingflow anhand von Referenzprodukten und -verträgen und leitest daraus die schrittweise Industrialisierung ab. Das bringst du mit. Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung als Technical Product Owner, IT Product Manager oder Solution Lead im Umfeld Pricing, Billing, Order-to-Cash oder Revenue Management. Zudem bringst du Kenntnisse in Preisfindung, Rating, Charging, Discounting, Fakturierung und den dafür benötigten Daten- und Integrationsflüssen mit. Du hast Erfahrung mit komplexen Standardlösungen und Integrationslandschaften, idealerweise mit SAP BRIM, S/4HANA oder vergleichbaren Plattformen. Diesen Job melden Would you like to work in a technological company dedicated to the development of medical solutions? Inpeco is the world leader in the automation of clinical laboratories , where we create innovative robotic solutions to manage biological samples. Our systems reduce the possibility of human error, limit the risks of contamination and guarantee complete traceability of the sample. Our solutions support over 2.700 clinical laboratories worldwide . The Inpeco Group has its headquarters in Novazzano (Switzerland) , a production plant in Val della Torre (Torino) , a site dedicated to Innovative Projects in Pula (Sardinia) , a small site in Verona and five reference locations for the foreign market in Belgium, United States, Germany, France and Spain. What are you waiting for? Come join the Inpeco team and innovate with us! Position: As a Design Quality Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, safety, and regulatory compliance of Inpeco's medical device products throughout their entire lifecycle. As part of the Quality team, you will lead Design Quality activities, providing strategic direction and technical guidance to ensure that product development processes meet applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, and business objectives. Collaborating closely with R&D, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, and other cross-functional stakeholders, you will oversee Design Quality activities for both hardware and software development, ensuring the effective implementation of Design Controls, risk management, verification and validation, and design transfer processes. You will also lead and develop the Design Quality Engineering team, fostering a strong quality culture, promoting continuous improvement, and ensuring that quality is embedded throughout the product development lifecycle. Main Responsibilities Lead and oversee global Design Quality activities throughout the entire product lifecycle, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, international standards, and internal Quality Management System procedures. Drive the implementation and maintenance of Design Controls, ensuring effective management of design inputs, outputs, design reviews, verification, validation, design transfer, and design changes. Act as the Design Quality subject matter expert for hardware and software development, providing technical guidance and supporting the review and approval of design documentation, technical specifications, procedures, test protocols, and reports. Ensure Design Quality oversight of software development activities, including compliance with IEC 62304, software risk management, cybersecurity and AI-related regulatory requirements, and software verification and validation. Oversee product risk management activities throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring compliance with ISO 14971, appropriate risk identification and evaluation, implementation of risk control measures, and maintenance of risk management documentation. Ensure alignment between design activities, risk management, verification and validation results, and post-market data to support ongoing product safety and effectiveness. Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Suppliers, and other cross-functional teams to ensure that quality and regulatory requirements are effectively integrated into product development and lifecycle management. Lead, manage, and develop the Design Quality Engineering team, providing technical guidance, coaching, mentoring, and performance management while fostering accountability and a strong quality mindset. Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring the effective management and resolution of Design Quality-related findings. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance Design Quality processes, strengthen regulatory compliance, and support global business objectives. Requirements: Skills And Experience Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. At least 7 years of experience in Quality Engineering within the medical device industry, including at least 4 years of specific experience in Design Quality. At least 1 year of experience in people management, with demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop technical teams. Strong knowledge of applicable medical device regulations and international standards, including ISO 13485, ISO 14971, 21 CFR Part 820, and EU MDR 2017/745 or EU IVDR 2017/746. Proven experience in Design Controls and medical device design and development processes, including design reviews, verification, validation, and design transfer. Solid understanding of hardware and software development processes within the medical device industry. Experience in product risk management throughout the product lifecycle, including risk analysis, risk evaluation, risk control, and risk management documentation. Knowledge of applicable software development standards, particularly IEC 62304, as well as cybersecurity and emerging AI-related regulatory requirements. Experience supporting internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and risk-based approach to decision-making. Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, drive initiatives, and deliver results within established timelines. Proactive, flexible, and adaptable, with the ability to operate effectively in an international and rapidly evolving environment. Fluent in English; Italian is a plus. Nice to Have Previous experience in a global medical device organization and in managing international or cross-functional teams. Experience with both hardware and software medical device development, particularly within complex or integrated systems. Knowledge of cybersecurity requirements and emerging regulatory frameworks for AI-enabled medical devices. Experience with post-market surveillance, complaint handling, and the integration of post-market data into product risk management and design activities. Experience with process improvement methodologies and Quality Management System optimization. Knowledge of project management methodologies and tools. Ability to promote and communicate quality objectives effectively, influence stakeholders, challenge existing practices, and drive continuous improvement. Other information: What We Offer Dynamic work environment where you can make a difference and grow your career International work location in our headquarter in Switzerland (Novazzano) Flexible working hours Working time account: possibility to accrue additional hours of free time in addition to holidays Additional contribution to the pension fund Professional and non-professional accident insurance Company restaurant Incentives for mobility by public transport Agreements for bank account, credit card and personal purchases Opportunity of professional and salary growth through various initiatives: Annual performance appraisal in order to evaluate the achievement of individual objectives Internal job posting to apply for career opportunities in Inpeco, even between different locations Annual salary review linked to performance and professional development Continuous training on the job, through meetings or conferences, seminars and events. Company Description Globus Travel Services, based in Switzerland, supports the Globus family of brands with essential administrative, operational, and other support services. These efforts ensure global operations run smoothly behind the scenes. The Globus family includes premium guided tours, affordable travel experiences with Cosmos, river cruises with Avalon Waterways, and independent travel planning with Globus. We are driven by passion and uphold values of accountability, courage, collaboration, integrity, and service. Role Description This is a fixed term , on-site role located in Lugano for a River cruises operations junior associate . The Operations Junior Associate supports the end-to-end coordination of cruise operations, ensuring the smooth delivery of services before, during, and after each river cruise. This role plays a vital part in maintaining service accuracy, guest satisfaction, and operational efficiency through day-to-day administrative tasks, supplier coordination, and direct support to onboard staff. Responsibilities Collect, update, and verify passenger information to ensure accurate reservations and efficient service planning. Prepare and maintain passenger lists for hotels, transfers, excursions, and third-party suppliers. Coordinate and confirm land services, including transfers, local tours, guides, and hospitality arrangements. Book and update flight and train tickets for passengers, staff members, and operational needs. Handle operational enquiries and updates from overseas sales offices and customer care teams before, during, and after each cruise. Provide basic IT support to onboard staff, assisting them with internal systems, checklists, and reporting tools. Support team members with administrative activities and daily tasks, helping colleagues become familiar with internal systems and procedures. Requirements Good knowledge of Office365 tools. Proficient in both spoken and written English. Excellent work organization: ability to structure, plan, and manage tasks and time effectively to achieve goals in a productive and orderly manner. Result oriented and with good ability to meet deadlines. Ability to work effectively under pressure. Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to understand and respond effectively to colleagues’ and customers’ needs.
